name: printed-loop-wand
status: Provisional first print set. Model geometry is generated and checked; printed fit, strength, comfort and mass are not measured.
frame: Assembly axes: +Z runs from the handle butt (z = 0) to the tip, +Y is the button side, the loop hangs toward -Y. Angles are measured from +Y toward +X, which is clockwise seen from the tip.

printer_reference.note: Reference profile only. Slicer estimates are recorded in the README; nothing has been physically printed.

overall.note: Butt to legacy Puck tip cap. The current XIAO tip uses the same shafts and ends slightly shorter; see the generated layout.

section.note: Loop handles use a 22 mm slab with 45-degree chamfers. Shared rail and socket overhangs still need slicer support checks.

round.label: Round
round.grip: Small loop for two fingers; thumb on the buttons.

oval.label: Oval
oval.grip: Full-hand mug loop around four fingers, so the wand stays on a relaxed hand.

angled.label: Angled
angled.grip: Raked loop, deeper at the palm, for a less bent wrist while pointing.

straight.label: No loop
straight.grip: Rounded straight grip with no loop. Least material of the four; same socket, rail and wire route.
straight.note: 24 mm round section. Prints on its side on an 11.9 mm flat reached by 45-degree faces; a 10 mm flat on top seats the rail.

joint.type: Push in, then twist 38 degrees clockwise (seen from the tip) to lock.

cam.note: The pin rides a ramp, passes a ridge and settles into a shallow pocket: the joint is pulled tight and resists turning back. Interference values are starting points to tune with the coupons.

shaft.note: Octagonal shaft in two glued half-lap sections so each fits the bed lying flat.

tip.note: Puck.js v2.1 stock case documented as 36 mm by 12.5 mm; not measured here.

xiao_tip.boards: Seeed XIAO nRF52840 Sense, or XIAO MG24 Sense; which one this wand carries is not physically confirmed. Both document a 21 x 17.8 mm footprint (Seeed wiki).
xiao_tip.note: Open U-shaped deck: the board lies component side up, USB end forward and uncovered, held by tape through the side notches. Only the outline comes from documentation; PCB thickness and component height are provisional clearances, not measurements. No battery holder: the battery is taped on separately.

tapered.note: One continuous tapered wand with no separate handle bulge. Every tapered part prints upright, wide end down. The double-helix and smooth versions share these values; the smooth one sets the rib height to zero.

thumb_shelf.note: One flat button platform across the top: left, centre and right zones on a common plane. Blank mounting surface; no guessed switch holes.

tapered.joint_note: Same spigot, pins, socket, cam and clearances as the other profiles, but mirrored: the handle carries the spigot and the lower shaft carries the socket, so both print upright.

xiao.label: XIAO tip
xiao.note: No button pod and no battery holder on the current XIAO wand.

pod.note: Generic button carrier. Switch size is unknown: the pilot holes mark button centres to drill out after measuring the real switches.
